description:
Boost a post Siren made: it becomes a Meta ad with its own picture
or video and caption, sent PAUSED. No credits; nothing spends until
go_live_ad_campaign and the human's yes. Without run_id it lists the
posts that did best lately so you can pick one with the human. A post
boosted before answers with that campaign.

daily_budget_cents.description: Budget a day in minor units (2000 is $20), inside the caps.

days.description: How long the ad runs once on, 1 to 90; 7 if omitted.

run_id.description: The post's run_id. Omit to list the posts worth boosting.

name: boost_post
